bio: Abdul Moiz Qureshi is a graduate of Quaid-i-Azam University, Islamabad, in Defence and Strategic Studies.
He is passionate about journalism, geopolitics and international affairs, with a keen interest in how media shapes public narratives and influences how people see global and national issues.
